requirements.statement: For SingleCamera, persist the WPD serial digest as identity and treat SDK selection only as exactly-one-current-session without persisting the colliding SDK Name or Interface. For DualCamera, keep a memory-only DualIdentitySessionBinding in the same Agent process; never treat candidate source ID, ordinal, enumeration order, or USB port as persistent identity. Agent restart, USB reconnect, camera-count or topology change, SDK manager regeneration, any SDK error, unconfirmed WPD cleanup, or Agent/binding-session terminal teardown invalidates the binding and unloads a retained Module. On unconfirmed WPD cleanup, call no SDK API including End, isolate and terminal the Agent, report the invalidation reason upward, and require a new binding. A pair terminal may preserve only a valid binding with confirmed WPD cleanup as a future no-re-enumeration boundary. The current slice ends at the coexistence probe and one-shot software gate: the same-binding 10/100 runner is not implemented and its compatibility with the fixed 600-second host lifetime is unresolved, so 10/100 runs must not start or be reported Pass. Return HardwarePending until a new binding completes after invalidation. Preserve the existing a0.camera-agent.hardware-dual.v2 payload/result shapes, use a0.camera-agent.hardware-dual-binding.v1 for binding, and use a0.camera-agent.hardware-dual-capture-recovery-only.v1 only for CaptureRecoveryOnly start, same-ID query, and close; advertise only the additive operation name through v2 capabilities.

On unconfirmed WPD cleanup, call no SDK API including End, isolate and terminal the Agent, report the invalidation reason upward, and require a new binding. The current scope reaches the coexistence probe and one-shot software gate only; a separately implemented and verified same-binding runner plus a host-lifetime policy are prerequisites for 10/100 runs, which must not start or be reported Pass now.
